output.summary: A perennial climbing vine native to Mexico’s Atlantic and Pacific coastal plains. It has large heart-shaped leaves and showy, usually pink flowers that may bloom throughout the year. Its tubers and seeds are edible; Indigenous inhabitants of Baja California Sur historically toasted and ground the seeds or boiled them for fried cakes.
